title: Billing Timeliness Standard: Non-Covered Test-Strip Charges Posted Late
content:
**Standard.** On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, a non-covered item patient charge on a denied test-strip line that Larkfield posts more than 60 calendar days after the denial's posting date is reduced to 0.75 of itself, one posted 31 to 60 days after it to 0.9, and one posted within 30 days is not reduced.

The days are counted from the denial's posting date to the day the charge is posted.

| Days from the denial's posting date to the charge | Charge posted at |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | the full charge |
| 31 to 60 | 0.9 of the charge |
| 61 or more | 0.75 of the charge |

**Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical charge of 80.00)**

- Posted 30 days after the denial: 80.00. Posted 31 days after: 72.00.
- Posted 60 days after the denial: 72.00. Posted 61 days after: 60.00.
